author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Poco X6 Pro AetherSX2 Emulator PS2 14 Game Test MediaTek Dimensity 8300 Ultra
summary: ByArdanTR gives fourteen PS2 games equal two-minute windows on the Dimensity 8300 Ultra POCO X6 Pro, creating a consistent recorded benchmark and explicitly estimating a three-frame capture penalty.

blocks.text: The twenty-eight-minute run identifies a 12 GB, 512 GB POCO X6 Pro with Mali-G615 MC6 and presents fourteen fixed-duration tests. Burnout 3, both God of War games, Midnight Club 3, three Need for Speed entries, Shadow of the Colossus and Tekken 5 create repeated chances to observe speed and graphics behavior. Equal windows reduce selective editing differences between titles, while the creator’s note that recording costs roughly three FPS at least acknowledges measurement overhead.

A flat three-FPS estimate cannot replace frame-time data and may vary with resolution, encoder load, temperature and each game’s bottleneck. The upload does not name AetherSX2 build, renderer, driver, internal resolution, ambient conditions or exact scenes beyond timestamps. Brief fixed windows omit late-game complexity and prolonged thermal saturation. Use the sequence for within-device comparisons, not as proof that every Dimensity 8300 phone behaves alike. Reproduce one difficult location without capture and log clocks, temperatures and settings before comparing other SoCs.
